facts.fact: Media Rights Agenda reports that the Freedom of Information Act, 2011 is in force and gives a right of access to information held by public bodies, as shown by a Federal High Court judgment enforcing it in 2026; the year 2011 is the Act's year as named in the report.

A Federal High Court in Lagos (Justice Aneke) ruled on 24 February 2026, in a suit on a journalist's October 2020 request, that the Nigeria Shippers Council breached the Freedom of Information Act and ordered it to disclose the information or give reasons for withholding it.
